request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:FARM

layers.text: Change only two things. Make the gravestones a lighter slate blue-grey (#8b92a3) with a mid slate shade (#6a7082), clearly lighter than the fence and the earth. Make the plot of earth a flat thin patch with no thick dark side walls under it. Keep the dark iron fence, the bare tree, the violet lantern flame, the size, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
